title: Owl eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x="10" y="78" width="80" height="6" rx="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <rect x="10" y="78" width="80" height="2" rx="1" fill="#A0714A"/>

  <!-- owl body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="24" ry="26" fill="#7B4FA0"/>
  <!-- body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="15" ry="18" fill="#A87FD0"/>
  <!-- belly feather pattern -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#C9AAE8"/>

  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="60" rx="9" ry="18" fill="#6A3F8F"/>
  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="60" rx="9" ry="18" fill="#6A3F8F"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#7B4FA0"/>
  <!-- facial disc -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#B592D8"/>

  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points="30,20 36,12 40,24" fill="#6A3F8F"/>
  <polygon points="70,20 64,12 60,24" fill="#6A3F8F"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="35" r="8" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="35" r="8" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="35" r="4" fill="#3A1A5E"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="35" r="4" fill="#3A1A5E"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="33.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="33.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points="47,42 53,42 50,50" fill="#FFA726"/>

  <!-- snack: a mouse held in right wing -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="52" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#9E7B6B"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="50" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#9E7B6B"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#3A1A5E"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="49" r="1.2" fill="#3A1A5E"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="52" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#B08D7B"/>
  <path d="M82,51 Q86,49 84,53" stroke="#E88FA0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <path d="M42,84 L40,90 M42,84 L44,90 M42,84 L42,90" stroke="#FFA726" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58,84 L56,90 M58,84 L60,90 M58,84 L58,90" stroke="#FFA726" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
